passiveBonuses.desc: Camel units emit an aura that reduces nearby enemy cavalry attack speed by 20%.
The House of Wisdom supports 4 upgradeable Wings (Economic, Military, Trade, Culture) each granting empire-wide bonuses when researched.

age2.bonus: Produces Scholars for free over time. Each Scholar garrisoned here generates +1 gold per second passively.
All trade routes generate +30% more gold. Unlocks a unique Camel Caravan trade unit that cannot be converted.

age3.bonus: All friendly units within 20 tiles regenerate 1 HP per second. Units heal 50% faster when out of combat.
Resource conversion trades at 1:1 ratio (normally 2:1). Unlocks excess resource conversion every 30 seconds automatically.

age4.bonus: All four Wings can be upgraded to their Imperial tier, granting doubled bonuses. Acts as an additional Town Center.
Trade income doubled. Each active trader generates +0.5 gold per second regardless of route distance.

uniqueUnits.special: Passive debuff aura reduces enemy cavalry attack speed by 20% in a 3-tile radius. Resistant to conversion by Monks.
Can fire arrows while moving at full effectiveness. Applies the camel debuff aura on nearby enemy cavalry.
Elite infantry with bonus damage against archers. Can briefly shield nearby friendly units from ranged attacks.

uniqueTech.effect: Economic Wing: Farms generate +2 food per minute. All Mill technologies are free.
Military Wing: All units gain +1 armor. Barracks and Stable production speed increased by 15%.
Trade Wing: Trade route gold generation increased by +50%. Traders gain +20% movement speed.
Culture Wing: All technologies research 25% faster. Scholars are produced for free every 60 seconds.

economic.bonus: Farms generate +2 food per minute, and all Mill technologies are free.
